pages.title: Heater Upgrades
pages.text: More heating power and a wider open-camp radius.

pages.title: Tiers
pages.text: $(bold)Iron$(): 50 output, 9 blocks, 1.5x fuel$(br)$(bold)Gold$(): 65, 11 blocks, 2x$(br)$(bold)Diamond$(): 80, 14 blocks, 3x$(br2)In sealed rooms, room shape sets coverage; output sets warm-up speed.

pages.title: Phases
pages.text: Full-rate fuel use: $(bold)2x$() in Phase 4, $(bold)4x$() in 5, $(bold)8x$() in 6. Throttling lowers the real burn.$(br2)From Phase 5, an open-camp heater under open sky keeps 0.6x radius. A roof keeps it all.

pages.title: Iron Heater
pages.text: Eight iron around a Thermal Heater. Good for Phases 3-4.$(br2)$(flavor)Warmer and hungrier, like Kevin at a buffet.$()

pages.title: Gold Heater
pages.text: Eight gold around a Thermal Heater.

pages.title: Diamond Heater
pages.text: Eight diamonds around a Thermal Heater.$(br2)$(flavor)ORSA Engineering has never heard of "affordable."$()
